description: This file defines the ConnectivityCommand interface, which is a base for all connectivity-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto platform. It includes method signatures, constants, and inner class for JSON field definitions relevant to implementing connectivity commands.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommand
classes.description: A base interface for all connectivity commands, providing constants and default method implementations related to connectivity actions.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Inner class defining JSON field constants specific to connectivity commands, particularly the 'connectionId' field.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection as a string; deprecated in favor of getConnectionEntityId.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId object representing the connection entity.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Default method returning the connection entity ID, overrides method from Command interface.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path; default implementation.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for connectivity commands.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string used for connectivity command types.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method for setting DittoHeaders, returns an instance of T.
